completeEntryUnchanged.name: closure
completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Ordinary Banishment; only AC5-BANISH-EXT-01 extends its named portions

exactAuthority.classification: NEW Banishment-only finite ending. The spell-cell ends; physical fit is then handed to the accepted canonical BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST placement-conflict procedure rather than protected closure anchors.
exactAuthority.trigger: Every Banishment application ending invokes closure: deadline, concentration end, valid Xi/end/suppression, or primary legal escape. Invoke even for an empty cell; an empty ephemeral cell simply ceases.
exactAuthority.originPlane: At successful establishment snapshot the primary target's actual origin-plane identity as an opaque existing plane reference and its fixed world anchor/orientation. The anchor never rides with a later-moving platform/vehicle. This records location only and does not name or settle cosmology.
exactAuthority.secondaryAnchors: When a secondary body first legally establishes in the cell, record a deterministic origin-plane closure anchor by projecting its cell-local horizontal/vertical offset from the primary local origin onto the primary's fixed world axes. This creates metadata only: no origin-plane space is reserved, protected, excluded or altered.
exactAuthority.looseObjectAnchors: At closure start, carried gear remains with its actual carrier. For each genuinely loose surviving object, project its current cell-local position onto the primary fixed world anchor to obtain an item placement anchor. Consumed/destroyed/escaped objects are absent.
exactAuthority.mandatoryPlaneReturn: For every remaining extant body/corpse/object, end the extraplanar spell state and assign it to the snapshotted origin plane before physical placement. This transition is mandatory and is not a voluntary teleport.
exactAuthority.endpointBlockerException: NEW narrowly scoped Banishment terminal exception: if a current Dimensional Anchor or other true endpoint transport-prevention predicate would block this mandatory closure transition, ignore only that prevention predicate for the terminal return. Do not ignore physical terrain, occupancy, anatomy, support, death/body removal, item existence or any voluntary-travel rule. This exception grants no future transport privilege and cannot be used for escape or another spell.
creatureOrder: primary current body/corpse if still present
secondary creature bodies by stable admission order
exactAuthority.creaturePlacement: For each returned creature/corpse in order, apply BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md Placement and involuntary endings at that entity's closure anchor: (1) normal current-anatomy space at same position; (2) legal squeeze under COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md; (3) nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, using minimum displacement, then greatest overlap with the previous/anchor footprint, then the fixed neutral board order. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space and does not search farther afield.
exactAuthority.multiEntityPlacement: Resolve entities in the stated stable order. A body already legally placed is ordinary occupied space for later entities. If that leaves a later entity with no same-anchor/squeeze/nearest-adjacent candidate, the later entity records a placement conflict; earlier legal placements are not undone.
exactAuthority.placementConflictState: If the inherited same-anchor → legal squeeze → nearest legal adjacent/same-unobstructed-region placement procedure produces no legal footprint, Banishment still ends and the cell is destroyed. Preserve the same extant identity on the snapshotted origin plane with placementConflict=true and a fixed closureAnchorReference. NEW BAN-CONFLICT-04 does not create a global body condition: it adds only Banishment-origin conflict semantics. The closureAnchorReference is the creature's logical spatial location for measuring range and evaluating source predicates while no legal occupied footprint exists. Do not grant movement, adjacency, occupancy, cover, squeezing, wall passage, overlap, flanking, support contact or other footprint-dependent benefits merely from that reference. Perception and line of effect are evaluated from the closureAnchorReference through the actual current terrain using the exact source's normal rules; solid barriers can therefore block them. Self-targeting and other effects that do not require a legal occupied footprint may still be used if all of their own prerequisites are met. Actions/Reactions are not categorically forbidden: evaluate each one by its actual activation, component, range, target, perception, path and geometry requirements. Ordinary movement cannot begin because there is no legal occupied footprint/path origin, but an independently legal relocation effect can resolve the conflict if it can lawfully use the anchor reference as its source location and establish a legal destination. All HP, Wounds, conditions, concentration, summon, death and other real clocks continue. Already-attached effects remain attached unless their own source ends them. When an obstruction is actually removed/changed so placement becomes possible, rerun the inherited placement procedure from the same anchor with the then-current anatomy; that mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no movement riders. When a legal relocation effect succeeds, move the same identity to its legal destination and clear placementConflict.
exactAuthority.fallingAndSupport: Evaluate real terrain/support at the closureAnchorReference for source predicates while placementConflict persists, but do not invent an occupied footprint. A conflicted body does not begin Falling merely because the reference point is unsupported; ordinary Falling begins when the body is actually placed in a legal unsupported footprint or a legal relocation establishes one. If closure itself finds a legal unsupported footprint, place the body there and start ordinary Falling immediately. Banishment never moves the body directly to ground.
exactAuthority.objects: After creature handling, settle loose noncreature objects by stable object-ID using the existing equipment rule: place at its anchor/current legal item position or nearest legal adjacent item position; if no legal drop exists, record that item's placement as pending. It continues to exist and is not duplicated, destroyed or used to displace another creature.
exactAuthority.deathAndRemoval: Mandatory death, source expiry, concentration ending, Polymorph reversion, actual-0-HP ending, cargo release and other true source events are never failed or delayed for Banishment geometry. A remaining corpse returns as that same corpse. A vanished/expired summon body is not recreated. Hunted Death/finality and ordinary item provenance remain unchanged.
exactAuthority.cellEnd: After every remaining identity is either legally placed, recorded as an origin-plane placement conflict/pending item, or confirmed absent, destroy the ephemeral cell immediately. No placement conflict keeps Banishment or its concentration alive.

completeEntryUnchanged.name: AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01
completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only the AC6 source relationships expressly covered by exactAuthority; no automatic extension to unrelated spells, profiles, global rules or cosmology.

exactAuthority.classification: NEW AC6 scoped same-body full-suppression lifecycle
rule: NEW explicit scope for these three AC6 profiles: while any part of the actual occupied body intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, apply this whole-body suppression lifecycle. Use the field's actual clipped volume and re-evaluate as the body moves or falls. This extends the accepted AC5 summon-intersection convention only to Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally and each Faction Army soldier; it does not suppress a whole extended wall/field, grant a new effect to another antimagic source, or change accepted AC5 rules.

Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. Preserve the same body identity, HP, Null state, current position, real cargo, source parent and original deadline. All real clocks continue.

While fully suppressed, the body has Speed0 and cannot act, command, attack or provide intrinsic attacks/traits/service permissions supplied by the suppressed source. Narrow rider-only suppression affects only that rider.

Air Pet physical clarification: full suppression suppresses its intrinsic fly/hover expression. If it is unsupported, ordinary Falling begins immediately under the existing Falling bridge. Falling is not frozen by the summon pause. If support is reached before suppression ends, the same body remains there; when suppression ends, its intrinsic fly/hover expression resumes from its actual current state and location. NullDisabled0 by itself does not suppress Hover; the ordinary Combat Action Hover exception still applies there while the source manifestation remains active.

If the original source independently expires, is replaced, dismissed, loses concentration where required, or otherwise ends while suppressed, the body ends normally. If suppression ends first, the same body resumes with no missed action/command replay and no HP/deadline refresh.

completeEntryUnchanged.name: Planar Barrier
completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only the AC6 source relationships expressly covered by exactAuthority; no automatic extension to unrelated spells, profiles, global rules or cosmology.

exactAuthority.activationAndGeometry: KEEP Abjuration6, Action,60feet,V/S/F,base13RP and concentration up to60elapsed seconds. NEW choose a fixed vertical rectangular wall up to30feet wide and15feet high, with1foot thickness, resting on actual ground. Choose its full position/orientation before commitment; every point must be within60feet and caster line of effect at formation. Width and height use whole5foot panels, producing at most18panels. No curved dome, moving wall or physical material is supplied. The initial volume must be free of creature bodies and solid terrain; known conflict fails preflight, a hidden conflict discovered at resolution defeats the whole paid formation. The wall is visible but transparent to ordinary sight/sound and does not itself supply cover.
exactAuthority.eligibility: NEW PB-PRED-01, scoped only to this wall: a creature qualifies if an actual operative source explicitly classifies it as extraplanar, or an actual established native-plane relationship places its native plane elsewhere than the wall's plane. A mere current visitor is not assigned a native plane. A record that expressly changes/suppresses that classification is honored for its stated duration. Without either affirmative established basis, this wall imposes no blocking branch; that operational absence is not proof the creature is native or non-extraplanar. Elemental, Fey, Fiend, Humanoid, summoned, outsider and extraplanar are not interchangeable labels. The Director may record a genuinely NEW campaign creature classification explicitly before play, but may not claim it was recovered from cosmology or infer it from a hidden soul theory.
exactAuthority.physicalCrossing: An operative panel blocks a qualifying creature's attempted voluntary or forced physical crossing at its boundary, including that body carried, dragged, grappled or ridden by another. Every separately transported creature retains its own eligibility; hiding a qualifying passenger under a cloak does not turn it into gear. Stop the actual crossing transaction before any qualifying body intersects the panel; no part is severed, squeezed through by changing its name, or left behind without an independently legal release. Movement used to reach the boundary remains spent; impossible remaining movement is not performed. A nonqualifying carrier can release the passenger through its actual available action and move alone if then legal. Nonqualifying bodies, ordinary objects, air, sound and actual attacks pass under their own rules. Going around a real edge remains possible. The wall deals no damage, imposes no extra save and grants no free force or opportunity attack. CURRENT EXPLICIT VERTICAL-FALL EXCEPTION: apply fallingAndPlacement below when gravity carries a body down through a top/bottom edge; the wall supplies no horizontal supporting face. This exception does not authorize lateral passage through an otherwise operative broad vertical face.
exactAuthority.fallingAndPlacement: Selective wall supplies no horizontal support. Unsupported Falling continues under the ordinary Fall Marker. QUALIFICATION-CHANGE branch: if an existing body becomes qualifying while intersecting an otherwise operative fixed5x5 panel, that entire panel is pending until no qualifying body intersects it; it supplies no blocking while pending. This whole-panel rule is for a body becoming qualifying inside an operative panel, not for antimagic clipping. NEW explicit completion for the existing no-platform promise: downward Falling through a top/bottom edge is not stopped by this selective wall. If that lawful vertical entry creates actual interior body overlap with a fixed panel, mark the whole intersected panel pending until qualifying bodies clear, exactly as for qualification-change occupancy. Other operative panels still block lateral crossing. A lateral forced movement component toward an operative face stops at its boundary while the independent unsupported vertical fall keeps its original marker/distance history. No support, extra save, impact damage or new Fall Marker is supplied by the wall itself.
exactAuthority.teleportAndTerminalReturn: The wall checks an actual transport destination footprint against its operative thickness for qualifying creature bodies; a destination that intersects is barred by this scoped magical endpoint-prevention rule. A fitting destination beyond the wall does not cross a fictitious physical path and is permitted unless another actual rule prevents that transport. An origin alone touching the wall does not bar leaving. Apply each transport source's normal atomic failure/payment rule. Ordinary Banishment's accepted BAN-CLOSE-03 terminal return expressly overrides endpoint transport prevention: this wall cannot keep that ended cell open. It does not remove real terrain or other bodies. If that mandatory return legally places a qualifying body in the wall thickness, the occupied panel becomes pending under the rule above; no general voluntary-transit bypass is granted.
exactAuthority.suppressionAndEnding: The nonphysical ongoing rank6 wall has one parent and fixed5x5 panels. LOCAL-SUPPRESSION branch: a suppressor removes only the exact geometric portions it intersects while concentration/deadline continue. At resumption, each previously suppressed clear portion returns; an exact suppressed portion intersecting a qualifying body remains absent until clear. Unsuppressed portions were never removed. This clipped-portion rule is distinct from the qualification-change whole-panel pending rule. Losing actual ground support invalidates dependent panels for the remainder of this cast. One active Planar Barrier per caster. Expiry, concentration ending or eligible whole-source removal ends all panels.
exactAuthority.currentPanelPrecision: Fixed5ft panels remain the authored wall cells. For local suppression, preserve exact clipped intersection geometry; do not rectangularize a sphere. For qualification change in an otherwise operative panel, pending applies to the whole5ft panel. Neither branch crushes/ejects, tactically reselects a hole, or refreshes duration. For pending-panel occupancy use actual positive-volume interior overlap. Merely touching a neighboring panel face/edge does not occupy that panel. The one-foot wall thickness participates in spherical clipping; y=0 diagrams are cross-sections only.

completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only the AC6 source relationships expressly covered by exactAuthority; no automatic extension to unrelated spells, profiles, global rules or cosmology.

exactAuthority.castingAndProfile: KEEP Action,60feet,V/S/F,concentration up to60elapsed seconds, HP65, AC18,2d8 Wind Slash and 50% miss chance against qualifying projectiles. NEW form one Medium Elemental in a perceived unoccupied legal whole-body space within range/line of effect. Use AC6-GREATER-AIR-PET-PROFILE-01 exactly: body mass40lb; STR10 DEX18 CON14 INT4 WIS10 CHA6; walk30, fly40, Hover. Ordinary sight/hearing; no unprinted resistances, hands, tool use, passengers or cargo permission.
exactAuthority.commandAndAttack: Use the actual owner-wide Bonus Action command within60feet with owner perception/LoE and a spoken order the pet can hear. In the attached phase after owner turn it may use one movement budget and one melee spell attack at reach5 using original casting source current attack modifier; hit 2d8 slashing, no ability damage. One offensive companion Action total across all owner assets that numbered round. Without a command it may move defensively and Dodge while capable.
exactAuthority.projectileDefense: After an actual separate projectile would otherwise hit, and after legal attack rerolls/pre-hit interruptions but before damage/on-hit riders, roll one fair d2: 1 converts direct impact to Miss, 2 retains determined hit/critical. Qualifying projectiles are arrows, bolts, thrown weapons and source-described magical missiles that actually travel to the body; beams, touch, ambient/area effects and nonprojectile attacks do not qualify. One result governs that projectile/pet lineage and all direct hit components. Independent explosion geometry remains independent. Fate Coin may replace this d2 only when its own public-die, Reaction, held-coin, 30ft/LoE and original-roll-lineage gates pass.
exactAuthority.nullHealingAndEnding: One Greater Air Pet per caster, separate from lower Air Pet but sharing owner command/offense. Ordinary non-Null damage to0 ends the body. Qualifying Null damage to0 leaves the same NullDisabled0 body while source concentration exists; further Null damage does not refresh it. AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02 narrowly treats the existing body as a living ally/creature for otherwise legal ordinary HP healing such as Healing Rite; healing above0 clears only NullDisabled and does not reset source clock/HP maximum/conditions/command history. Expiry, concentration ending, replacement, dismissal or actual parent removal ends the body with no corpse/loot/harvest.
exactAuthority.suppression: Use AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01 exclusively. Full suppression preserves the same body/HP/deadline/cargo but suppresses source traits, including fly/hover. Unsupported Air Pet therefore begins ordinary Falling; the fall marker and impact resolve normally while the source clock continues. Rider-only suppression removes only that rider. No superseded early-destruction rule is current.
exactAuthority.damageRoot: A real Wind Slash root has dealer/root owner = Pet body, not its owner/controller. Veil/Null creation-time root logic follows the actual dealer.

completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only the AC6 source relationships expressly covered by exactAuthority; no automatic extension to unrelated spells, profiles, global rules or cosmology.

exactAuthority.castingAndFormation: KEEP Conjuration6, Action,60feet,V/S/F,base13RP and one hour of extraplanar assistance. NEW no concentration; exactly3600elapsed seconds from successful formation. Choose one perceived unoccupied actual10x10foot whole-body space with at least10feet vertical clearance in range and line of effect, on support capable of the body plus actual admitted cargo. Known illegality fails preflight; hidden or intervening invalidity defeats the paid formation without a substitute location. A countered cast creates no replacement. A successful new Greater Planar Ally replaces the caster's previous Greater Planar Ally, wherever it is, conserving real property.
exactAuthority.identityAndRole: NEW explicitly form the complete summon-only profile AC6-GREATER-PLANAR-ALLY-PROFILE-01. This is a new finite creature identity, not a transport/copy/conscription of a named existing person or an automatic grant to choose any printed CR6 monster. It preserves the source's CR6 assistance role as a design target. Eight actual CR6 entries in the bounded67-entry source candidate are preserved for comparison; none is treated as operationally approved or extraplanar solely from its type. The proposed120HP/AC17/two2d8+4 profile and intended challenge role need numerical playtesting. Extraplanar is an explicit source tag; no specific home/native plane or soul has been invented. Formation is this spell's creature-creation event, not traveler transit; a rule preventing actual planar travel does not automatically suppress creation unless its exact text covers it.
exactAuthority.commandAndAssistance: Use the actual owner-wide Bonus Action command during the owner's regular turn, within60feet, with owner perception/line of effect and a command the ally can actually hear. Execute one movement budget and one selected legal Action in the attached phase after the entire owner turn. A valid offensive command permits its two printed strikes within one offensive Action, not two owner commands. Choose legal targets and any lawful alternatives from what the owner actually perceives when commanding; revalidate reach, target and line of effect at each attack. Split the one movement budget before/between attacks if declared. A miss or invalid later target does not refund offense or grant a hidden new target. Other companions cannot spend a second offensive Action that numbered round. Without a command it may move defensively and Dodge while capable. No independent initiative turn or extra-turn reset is created.
exactAuthority.noncombatUse: A real command may direct its profiled basic Action, manipulation or Search. Carrying and movement use the actual profile and real spent time. It may move supplied cargo or manipulate an unattended simple object, but it supplies no automatic Help advantage, profession, autonomous offscreen project, expedition roster office, extra Watch, training or institutional service. It cannot perform a job requiring missing proficiency or an ability it lacks. Real gear, whole bodies, Load and weight are not erased by apparent magical anatomy. A prospective action must still be physically possible in the available geometry.
exactAuthority.healingNullAndEnding: Use AC6-GREATER-PLANAR-ALLY-PROFILE-01 and its narrow GA-HEAL-01 predicate. Qualifying Null damage to0 leaves same occupying NullDisabled0 body while its one-hour source exists; legal healing above0 restores same body without clock/command reset. Use AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01 for full suppression: same body/HP/deadline/cargo remain and activity/traits pause rather than ending/recreating. The caster may dismiss its own Ally on the caster's regular turn without an Action. A genuinely legal independent relocation of the same Ally does not dismiss it and preserves its source and remaining clock. Real one-hour expiry, replacement, dismissal or eligible parent removal ends it. At source ending, real carried/held objects drop once at actual position; intrinsic anatomy/attacks vanish without loot/corpse/XP/resource trigger.

exactAuthority.authoritativeProfile: Each formed body uses AC6-FACTION-SOLDIER-PROFILE-01 exactly: Medium 5x5, mass160lb, AC14, HP20, walk30, STR12 DEX12 CON12 INT8 WIS10 CHA8; saves use original source-owner current PB total; other checks use listed ability modifier absent exact proficiency. exactAuthority.commandAndBodies: All soldiers are separate bodies/HP/positions but share owner's existing one Bonus Action command and one offensive companion Action per numbered round with every other asset. No early-destruction suppression rule is current. Later faction standing/permission changes affect future casts/social consequences but do not retroactively end an admitted cohort absent an actual source-ending rule. Expiry/concentration ending/eligible parent removal ends all remaining bodies; intrinsic equipment vanishes and real cargo drops once.
exactAuthority.damageRoot: Each commanded soldier attack has dealer/root owner = that soldier body, not owner/controller.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; concentration up to one minute. Create one Medium Elemental companion in a perceived fitting unoccupied supported space with line of effect. Preserve printed AC 14, HP 35, 2d6 healing and 1d10 cold attack. NEW profile: walking Speed 30 feet, body mass 150 pounds, all six ability scores 10, saves equal to your PB, other checks +0, ordinary sight/hearing. It understands your spoken commands without speech or telepathy. No swimming, amphibious trait, fluid passage, immunity or free water follows from its name. It acts immediately after your regular turn. A Bonus Action command while within 60 feet and able to perceive you permits movement and one attack, heal, Dodge, Dash, Disengage or Search. Without a command it can move defensively and Dodge. No free Help, grapple, shove, item activation or opportunity attack is granted. Attack: one melee spell attack using your actual casting ability + PB, reach 5 feet, 1d10 cold without a modifier. Heal: one willing ally it perceives within 5 feet and line of effect regains 2d6 ordinary HP without a modifier. Under NEW scoped AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01, this AC4 Water Pet and the AC4 Faction Envoy are mechanically eligible living allies for ordinary healing while their body exists; this does not establish natural origin, biology, soul or corpse identity. A Downed recipient is eligible under its actual healing rules. NEW: either attack or heal consumes the owner’s one shared companion offensive/support activation for that numbered round. One companion therefore cannot heal while another uses that same offensive allowance. Each command still costs its actual Bonus Action; extra turns or repeated commands add no activations. Healing belongs to the pet, without triggering the owner’s personal spell, lifesteal or class hooks; no healing copy, resource conversion or overflow is added. One Water Pet per caster; successful replacement ends the old body. Ordinary non-Null damage that reaches 0 invokes the source finite-summon endpoint and ends the body without corpse, loot, death reward or material water. A qualifying Null root instead uses the Disabled-at-0 exception below. It can carry genuinely entrusted existing gear within its actual capacity; real cargo drops legally on ending. Suppression preserves the existing body/HP and deadline without movement, attack, healing or a fresh summon trigger until resumption.

CURRENT NULL/LIFECYCLE INTERFACE — A qualifying `nullNonlethal=true` damage root that reduces this finite summoned companion from positive HP to 0, or later strikes that same already-`Null Disabled 0` body, does not end, replace or reapply the body/state. Use the accepted `finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast` branch: the same identity becomes `Null Disabled 0` (Incapacitated, Speed 0, no Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions/commands) while the original spell/concentration/deadline continues. Independent concentration end, duration expiry, dismissal or replacement still ends the body. A real healing source whose targeting applies under AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01 can raise it above 0 and end Disabled; no generic free heal, resummon refresh, or corpse/loot is created.
NEW scoped command decision: its printed 2d6 heal deliberately spends the owner's one shared companion offensive/support activation for that numbered round, the same allowance its attack would spend. Pure movement/Dodge without that heal/attack does not spend the offensive/support allowance beyond the ordinary Bonus Action command.
completeCurrentCard.newChoices: NEW: complete finite body/command profile, melee/healing ranges, and one owner-wide activation shared by attack and healing. Printed healing and attack remain alternatives.
historicalWorkedCases: A commanded 2d6 heal can restore a living ally at 0 HP if no actual restriction blocks healing. It spends the round’s shared companion activation.
The pet has no swim mode simply because it looks like water. Its disappearance produces no harvestable water.

completeSharedRules.castingEngine: Use SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md exactly: legal action/components/target/repertoire first; class-specific rank/cost; pre-cast Dissonance; commit RP/materials/concentration; apply Dissonance/Refrain/cast-begin hooks; resolve interruption; then effect. Failed/countered/saved casts refund nothing.
completeSharedRules.timing:
One-minute concentration effects use the source's normal ten future caster regular-start markers in initiative or 60 elapsed seconds outside unless this card states a different exact clock. Ten minutes = 100 future caster regular-start markers or 600 elapsed seconds. Alignment Lock uses 24 elapsed hours; rank-7 Alignment Anchor uses seven elapsed days; Bind Element uses two future target regular ends / 12 elapsed seconds outside initiative. Preserve virtual/absolute deadlines through initiative changes, absence and suppression.
SPELL SHIELD EXACT CLOCK — Because Spell Shield is nonconcentration, its own one-minute deadline is explicit: in initiative, application records the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application, excluding any start already in progress or past. Outside initiative, deadline = application timestamp + 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve that fixed virtual/absolute deadline across initiative entry/exit, reorder, extra turns, absence, caster death and suppression. Caster death alone does not end Spell Shield.
completeSharedRules.null: Creation-time Null root identity remains governed by accepted EPI-08–14. Pure transfer/redirection preserves the root flag. New reflected/retaliatory damage only uses a new root when an exact effect says it creates new damage. Finite summons reduced to 0 by qualifying Null damage use the accepted Disabled branch while independent expiry/concentration/replacement remains real.
completeSharedRules.faction: Use standing-v1 separately from membership and invocation permission. Faction Seal's reviewed invocation-permission procedure is the permission reference where invoked. Positive standing never creates membership or permission.
completeSharedRules.alignment: Reviewed Alignment Purge AP-AS-01 remains exactly source-specific. AC4-ALIGN-01 is an additional NEW scoped exception only for Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor; it creates no universal alignment priority engine.
completeSharedRules.banishment: Banishment is not one of these fifteen. The earlier pre-push sequencing hold is historical. Its exact source receipt is preserved and it remains the next separate procedure-authoring obligation using current planes/souls sources.
completeSharedRules.summonTargeting: NEW scoped AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01: solely for the two authored AC4 temporary profiles Summon Water Pet and Faction Envoy, while their finite body exists they count as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This is a mechanical targeting classification only; it establishes no natural origin, biology, soul, corpse, loot, undead/construct taxonomy or cosmological identity. Null Disabled 0 remains the same existing body and may receive an otherwise legal heal; an ended/expired/dismissed body is no longer a target. Resonance Beacon uses active-creature identity rather than biological 'living' status: an enrolled creature must still be able to spend its own Action and RP.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP; concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds. Create one Greater Fire Pet in one perceived supported unoccupied footprint that fits its Medium body and has line of effect. Use AC5-PROFILE-GREATER-FIRE-PET-01 exactly: HP60, AC17, Speed30, commanded 5-ft Fire Strike for 2d10 fire using original owner's current spell attack, and the passive 5-ft aura.

The aura is not an entry trigger. At each perceived hostile recipient's future regular START while within 5 feet and body-to-recipient line of effect, make DEX vs original owner's current spell DC; failure takes 1d6 fire, success half floor. Max one aura attempt per owner/target/Greater-Fire-Pet family/numbered round, outside initiative once per six seconds. One d6 may be shared across the cycle but saves/defenses/damage roots are per recipient. The owner cannot use the aura as hidden allegiance detection: only creatures the conscious owner actually perceives/regards as hostile qualify.

Use shared Companion Command/global offense budget for Fire Strike; aura is the printed passive exception and does not grant another offensive Action. One Greater Fire Pet per owner, distinct from lower Fire Pet body cap but not from the owner-wide command/offense allowance.

Damage-root identity follows AC5-ROOT-01: commanded attack dealer=pet; each aura recipient root dealer=pet at that START. Owner Null Veil never automatically converts pet damage. Apply AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01/accepted Null lifecycle: qualifying Null damage to 0 keeps this same finite body Disabled 0 while concentration/source remains, including subsequent Null hits; legal Healing Rite/ordinary living-ally HP healing can restore above 0. Ordinary non-Null damage to 0 removes the body normally. Independent expiry/concentration/replacement still ends it.

Under Lesser Antimagic use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01. No fire immunity, extra light, fuel, generic Burning condition, corpse or harvestable elemental material is inferred.

AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.classification: NEW scope extension only for Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment; ordinary Banishment remains unchanged
reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission
ordinary Banishment custody/separate-creature and mandatory-body-ending rules
BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, copied only for these two AC5 exile applications
notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. Never settle only cargo when another extant identity exists, and never recreate the ended primary.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.intent: Before the printed CHA save record ACCEPT or RESIST exactly as ordinary Banishment. ACCEPT remains voluntary even if the target rolls and fails; RESIST+failed save is forced. For these two AC5 exiles, No Escape blocks ACCEPT because it names voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block because these applications are not teleportation. This is spell-local classification only.

AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

procedure.commandAndAttack: Use the actual owner-wide Bonus Action command within60feet with owner perception/LoE and a spoken order the pet can hear. In the attached phase after owner turn it may use one movement budget and one melee spell attack at reach5 using original casting source current attack modifier; hit 2d8 slashing, no ability damage. One offensive companion Action total across all owner assets that numbered round. Without a command it may move defensively and Dodge while capable.
procedure.projectileDefense: After an actual separate projectile would otherwise hit, and after legal attack rerolls/pre-hit interruptions but before damage/on-hit riders, roll one fair d2: 1 converts direct impact to Miss, 2 retains determined hit/critical. Qualifying projectiles are arrows, bolts, thrown weapons and source-described magical missiles that actually travel to the body; beams, touch, ambient/area effects and nonprojectile attacks do not qualify. One result governs that projectile/pet lineage and all direct hit components. Independent explosion geometry remains independent. Fate Coin may replace this d2 only when its own public-die, Reaction, held-coin, 30ft/LoE and original-roll-lineage gates pass.
procedure.nullHealingAndEnding: One Greater Air Pet per caster, separate from lower Air Pet but sharing owner command/offense. Ordinary non-Null damage to0 ends the body. Qualifying Null damage to0 leaves the same NullDisabled0 body while source concentration exists; further Null damage does not refresh it. AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02 narrowly treats the existing body as a living ally/creature for otherwise legal ordinary HP healing such as Healing Rite; healing above0 clears only NullDisabled and does not reset source clock/HP maximum/conditions/command history. Expiry, concentration ending, replacement, dismissal or actual parent removal ends the body with no corpse/loot/harvest.
procedure.suppression: Use AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01 exclusively. Full suppression preserves the same body/HP/deadline/cargo but suppresses source traits, including fly/hover. Unsupported Air Pet therefore begins ordinary Falling; the fall marker and impact resolve normally while the source clock continues. Rider-only suppression removes only that rider. No superseded early-destruction rule is current.
procedure.damageRoot: A real Wind Slash root has dealer/root owner = Pet body, not its owner/controller. Veil/Null creation-time root logic follows the actual dealer.

historicalQuestionAndRecord.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, concentration up to one minute, HP65, AC18,2d8 wind slash and50% miss chance against projectiles. NEW form one Medium Elemental in a perceived unoccupied legal whole-body space within range/line of effect. Base body mass40lb; STR10,DEX18,CON14,INT4,WIS10,CHA6; Fly40 with Hover and walk30. Ordinary sight/hearing, no darkvision or unprinted immunities/resistances. All six saving throws use original source-owner current PB as total modifier; other checks use listed ability modifiers without proficiency. No hands, tool operation, passenger support or cargo-carriage permission is granted by the wind body. Actual source-qualified maximum-HP modifiers apply to base65; healing cannot refill an ended body or reset its identity.

Use one actual owner BA command within60feet with owner perception/line of effect and a spoken order that the pet can hear. It understands only those simple command meanings, with no learned speaking language or sensory feed. In its owner's attached phase it may move and make one melee spell attack at reach5feet using the original casting source's current attack modifier. On hit deal2d8 slashing with no ability damage bonus; wind is the depiction, not a new damage type. Apply normal attack critical/defenses. It does not copy lower Air Pet's expressly printed two attacks. The real command/offensive allowance can support this attack on the creation turn only if still available; the casting Action itself supplies none. Otherwise it only moves defensively and Dodges while capable.

NEW projectile defense applies to each genuinely separate projectile whose direct impact would otherwise hit this pet: arrows, bolts, thrown weapons and actual source-described magical missiles traveling to it. A mere beam, touch, nonprojectile magical attack, area blast, ambient damage or source that only looks like a projectile without that actual mechanism does not qualify. After the projectile's actual hit determination and legal attack-roll rerolls/pre-hit interruptions, but before damage/on-hit riders, roll one fair d2 for this projectile/pet event:1 turns that direct hit into a Miss,2 leaves its determined hit/critical intact. Already-missed attacks roll no chance. A natural20 hit still faces this specific miss chance; a genuinely explicit source that ignores miss chances overrides it within scope. An automatic-hit projectile also receives this defense unless that source explicitly bypasses it. No attack/save/check reroll feature automatically rerolls this separate d2 unless its actual wording covers that chance roll.

Keep one chance result per projectile/defender event lineage. Multiple damage components of one projectile share it; a redirected/copy callback cannot reroll it as a new hit on the same body. Genuinely separate projectiles have separate chance results, even if their source used one attack roll. If a legitimate later effect actually reopens the original attack determination, retain the already-resolved chance for that same projectile rather than drawing until favorable. Deflection cancels that direct hit and its hit riders, not an independently legitimate area explosion at a real miss/scatter position specified by the original source. This grants no general explosion immunity, half damage, disadvantage or protection to other creatures. Multiple instances of this same defense do not add extra50% rolls.

One Greater Air Pet per caster, separate from lower Air Pet's identity but sharing all owner commands/offense. A genuinely formed new one replaces the old; ordinary concentration commitment may already have ended it. At zero HP, expiry, concentration end or actual source removal it vanishes with no corpse, item, harvest or free resummon. NEW full suppression of this created source ends this pet immediately, rather than storing an intangible body for return; narrowly scoped rider suppression affects only that rider. Any real object physically resting against/carried externally with it loses that support at its actual position under ordinary support/Falling rules. No weather control, unlimited air, wind cargo transport or planar-origin conclusion follows from this profile.
workedCases: AC6-07-A: Two arrows would hit the pet after their attack rolls. Their separate d2 results are1 and2: the first direct impact becomes a Miss with no on-hit rider, while the second retains its real hit and damage. A third arrow that already missed rolls no d2. A nearby area explosion remains an area effect and receives no projectile miss chance merely because its carrier was a thrown object.

AC6-07-B: One magical missile has lightning and necrotic components in a single direct impact. Its one d2 result controls that impact and both hit-dependent components; it does not get another50% attempt for each type. A commanded wind slash makes one2d8 slashing attack, not the lower pet's two attacks. Full suppression ends this proposed body without preserving a fresh65HP return.

historicalQuestionAndRecord.originalQuestion: Preserve HP65,AC18,2d8 WIND SLASH,and50% MISS CHANCE AGAINST PROJECTILES,Core Action/60ft/concentration up to1minute. Supply exact size,speed,attack/save statistics,range and attack count with NEW details marked. Compare the reviewed Air Pet without copying its two attacks or other statistics automatically. Define projectile classification and the actual timing/random method of the50% roll,including multiple projectiles,spell attacks,area effects,miss/hit rerolls and already-missed attacks. It is not generic disadvantage,half damage or all-attack immunity. Bind owner command/offensive allowance,creation-round execution,movement,suppression,death and finite no-harvest identity. After the projectile's actual hit determination and legal attack-roll rerolls/pre-hit interruptions, but before damage/on-hit riders, roll one fair d2 for this projectile/pet event:1 turns that direct hit into a Miss,2 leaves its determined hit/critical intact. Already-missed attacks roll no chance. A natural20 hit still faces this specific miss chance; a genuinely explicit source that ignores miss chances overrides it within scope. An automatic-hit projectile also receives this defense unless that source explicitly bypasses it. No attack/save/check reroll feature automatically rerolls this separate d2 unless its actual wording covers that chance roll.

Keep one chance result per projectile/defender event lineage. Multiple damage components of one projectile share it; a redirected/copy callback cannot reroll it as a new hit on the same body. Genuinely separate projectiles have separate chance results, even if their source used one attack roll. If a legitimate later effect actually reopens the original attack determination, retain the already-resolved chance for that same projectile rather than drawing until favorable. Deflection cancels that direct hit and its hit riders, not an independently legitimate area explosion at a real miss/scatter position specified by the original source. This grants no general explosion immunity, half damage, disadvantage or protection to other creatures. Multiple instances of this same defense do not add extra50% rolls.

One Greater Air Pet per caster, separate from lower Air Pet's identity but sharing all owner commands/offense. A genuinely formed new one replaces the old; ordinary concentration commitment may already have ended it. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching zero HP ends this finite body with no corpse, item, harvest or free resummon. Qualifying Null damage instead preserves this same source/body at NullDisabled0: Incapacitated, Speed0, no Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions/commands. Its actual Hover trait prevents a fall solely from Speed0 while the body/source remains; independent source ending still removes that support. Further qualifying Null hits cannot refresh it. Independent expiry, concentration end, replacement, dismissal or actual source removal still ends it, whether disabled or positive HP. NEW full suppression of this created source ends this pet immediately, rather than storing an intangible body for return; narrowly scoped rider suppression affects only that rider. Any real object physically resting against/carried externally with it loses that support at its actual position under ordinary support/Falling rules. No weather control, unlimited air, wind cargo transport or planar-origin conclusion follows from this profile.

NEW AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02: while this created finite creature body exists, expressly treat Greater Air Pet as a living ally/creature for otherwise legal ordinary HP healing, including actual Cleric Healing Rite. This is a scoped new target extension, not a claim about biology, soul, resurrection, native plane or applicability to every summon. Healing above0 ends this body's NullDisabled state, without resetting source deadline, HP maximum, conditions or command histories. It grants no free healing, rest pool or corpse/repair route. AC4 Water Pet/Envoy and pending AC5 Fire Pet/Champion extensions do not automatically grant this one.

For a projectile d2, actual Fate Coin can replace that one die only after its face is available to the reacting player, with a held available coin, real Reaction, perception of the actual local impact event within30feet/LoE, and the shared Mark Omen/Fate Coin original-roll-lineage guard unused. The projectile's earlier attack roll and the later d2 are separate roll events; multiple damage components are not multiple d2 events. A secret Director die is not revealed by the coin. A legal d2 replacement commits once and its final face owns the same event; a result1 removes the direct hit and its on-hit riders even if the original attack was natural20. A separate source-defined explosion uses its own real position/save and gets no d2 merely because a projectile delivered it.

A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
