AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.classification: NEW scope extension only for Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment; ordinary Banishment remains unchanged
reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission
ordinary Banishment custody/separate-creature and mandatory-body-ending rules
BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, copied only for these two AC5 exile applications
notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. Never settle only cargo when another extant identity exists, and never recreate the ended primary.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.intent: Before the printed CHA save record ACCEPT or RESIST exactly as ordinary Banishment. ACCEPT remains voluntary even if the target rolls and fails; RESIST+failed save is forced. For these two AC5 exiles, No Escape blocks ACCEPT because it names voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block because these applications are not teleportation. This is spell-local classification only.

AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

Its numerical rating and eventual acceptance are separate gates; none is authored or approved here.
contentLimitsUnchanged.conditionalAuthoredAcceptanceMeaning: A coherent procedure may be accepted with missing concrete content explicitly held. This is not a fulfilled positive scenario, creature rating, implemented fallback, executable feature or whole-game completion. Do not silently count either held case as complete.

exactAcceptedCompanionContextNotApplied.qualification: Complete exact accepted Companion10 context,not locally applied; its exactCR2 positive content holds remain. Source-local body/healing/suppression/order rules do not automatically govern these five new summons.

acceptedContextUnapplied.qualification: Accepted-but-unapplied complete Illusion/Control context. Current TrueSeeing,MassSuggestion,Soulburn/Reservoir and preparation-only copied-feat Ready choices remain settled in their actual scope. The751-check Ready receipt establishes no full game engine. These sources do not select new summon profiles,army throughput,unique herald eligibility,all-undead command or cosmos. Keep all five independent positive-content holds and pending source comparisons distinct.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: None of the five printed descriptions supplies a complete executable creature profile. Accepted defaults cover some missing ordinary values, but do not invent attacks, anatomy, type, mass, movement modes or a rated herald.
options: Author complete spell-specific profiles with each inherited default and each NEW field explicitly marked.
Bind genuinely complete existing native profiles where exact eligibility and all printed benefits are proven; author only the remaining fields.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Use actual native evidence first. Return complete positive-use profiles, source ownership and resource records; never substitute a foreign monster or mark a missing profile resolved by an eligibility guard.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The owner-wide one-command and one-offensive-companion allowance is accepted. Several new spells promise multiple attacks, an army, or control over all undead; their additional throughput is not specified.
options: Inherit the accepted shared allowances, expressly defining complete multiattack/pulse components within one real offensive opportunity.
Select and justify a named spell-local exception where necessary to preserve an army/control promise, with exact cross-family budgets.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not silently multiply allowances, or silently reduce the promised benefit for tabletop convenience. Identify the real gameplay tradeoff and every affected owner/controller/round ledger.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Creation, transport of an existing being, and a new control relation have different identity, source, cargo and death consequences. Names such as avatar/herald do not decide which exists.
options: Select a generated-body lifecycle for a source that actually supports that reading, with exact same-spell caps and replacement.
Select preexisting identity/transport or control where the wording requires it, with conserved records and an explicit return/ending contract.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select each identity separately. Keep no-concentration versus concentration, body death versus source removal, and old concentration ending before a failed replacement distinct. No free corpse, soul, inventory, XP or unlimited resummon refresh follows.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The AC4/AC5/AC6 living-ally healing extensions are named exceptions. Companion10 expressly does not extend them to every new summon. Actual Wizard Conjuration and eligible Flesh Ascendant maximum-HP rules are already settled.
options: Use only healing sources whose actual target predicate already admits the selected new body.
Author a precise healing-target extension for named new profiles without inventing biology or universally changing Undead/Construct targeting.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: State the eligible healing/repair routes and NullDisabled0 recovery for each profile. Inherit actual creation snapshots and dynamic controller bonuses without alias duplication or capacity-growth healing.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The avatar aura, rot aura and cone need source-local roots and repeated exposure rules. Existing Greater Fire Pet aura, AC6 companion roots and P20 pulse rules have different named scopes.
options: Use explicit per-recipient roots and a stated repeated-exposure schedule with declared family keys.
Use a single rolled pool where justified while retaining independent recipient saves, defenses and exact damage-root ownership.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify source body as actual dealer where it acts, original stat owner separately, critical versus save dice, concentration consequences and creation-time Null flags. No owner Veil, lifesteal, resource recovery or harmful repeated tick is inherited by name.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Accepted summon suppression differs: AC6 preserves occupied paused bodies, Companion Knight removes expression temporarily, and Companion Wraith ends its manifestation. None is a universal choice for these five.
options: Select a retained-body or pending-expression policy for each generated profile with exact geometry, identity, clocks and cargo.
Select a terminal expression ending, or suppression of control alone for an existing being, where explicitly justified.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define partial-body/local-area versus whole-parent suppression, rider-only suppression, pending orders, dispel capture, unsupported Falling and real expiry. A multi-body army requires individual and parent records; no heal, fresh turn or missed-pulse replay on resumption.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Summon Elemental Avatar prints HP180 but no body size, elemental choice, anatomy, mass, attack type or movement modes. The title does not imply all elements, all movement modes or deity embodiment.
options: One complete selected elemental profile, with any element fixed at formation.
A finite menu of complete source-local elemental variants preserving the same printed benefit set.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Provide exact occupied volume, actual mass, handling/carrying, respiration if relevant, attack/saves/checks and perception. Changing appearance or controller cannot refill HP or silently select a new element.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source says attacks 3x/round, rather than explicitly naming three Actions. Existing Air Pet multiple attacks can form one damaging Action, but the new per-round ceiling must remain real.
options: Three separately resolved attacks within one commanded offensive Action and one body/numbered-round allowance.
A precisely scheduled split-attack permission with the same genuine three-attack round ceiling and an explicit command exception.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Favor the inherited multiattack shape if it preserves all three attacks. Specify reach, attack/damage profile, target changes, movement between strikes, failed later targets, unused strikes, extra turns, control transfer and recasting.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Elemental resistances is a positive printed clause without an enumerated damage set. It does not say immunity, absorption, healing or adaptive invulnerability.
options: A fixed explicitly enumerated resistance set on the complete profile.
A selected elemental variant with an explicitly enumerated corresponding resistance set.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Retain useful plural resistances and state mixed-damage allocation, exact source-qualified penetration, suppression and form/control changes. Do not invent a missing global elemental-damage taxonomy.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Aura damage has no radius, amount, damage type, target category, trigger, save or overlap rule. Greater Fire Pet uses perceived hostile recipient future STARTs and is only a comparison.
options: A genuine passive aura with exact recipient/geometry/pulse/save/damage rules, distinct from the commanded three strikes.
An explicitly activated aura mode with a stated action relationship, only if the printed passive-looking benefit is consciously reconciled.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Require useful quantified aura behavior. State ally/caster/other-avatar exposure, actual LoE, entry versus START timing, outside-initiative cadence, suppression and whether a pulse consumes any allowance. No secret allegiance oracle.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Conjure Magmatic Wyrm gives a massive HP250 serpent that breathes 6d12 fire. Core duration Instantaneous does not define how long this creature exists or imply it vanishes before acting.
options: Treat Instantaneous as the creation event and author a precise nonconcentration body lifespan/endings.
Expressly reconcile Core to a selected sustaining duration/concentration procedure while preserving the original field unchanged as evidence.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select a useful actual lifetime, not an undefined permanent asset or a single instantaneous blast replacing the creature. Define same-spell caps, dismissal, paid replacement and behavior after caster incapacity/death.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Massive fire serpent supplies a body concept and HP250, but not a Size category, occupied dimensions, body mass, support, locomotion or handling.
options: One explicitly sized corporeal serpent profile with actual support and terrain interaction.
An explicitly magical supported body profile with each exceptional locomotion/weight rule individually stated.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Keep a substantial serpent body and exact fit. No flight, lava swimming, burrowing, wall passage, rideability, hands, infinite Load or intangibility arises from the name. State a genuinely legal formation and subsequent route.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The breath is specifically 6d12 fire in a cone; cone length, source origin, save/result, use cost and frequency are missing.
options: A complete commanded breath Action with a fixed per-round/recharge/use policy.
A complete alternative attack mode sharing its real offensive opportunity with other authored actions.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve six d12 and fire. Bind exact three-dimensional cone/witness geometry, minimum range if any, allies, cover/occlusion, save modifier/DC provenance, half/none outcome, dice pool, interruption and finite frequency. No imported dragon recharge.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No bite, claw, tail attack, spell list or breath-exhaustion fallback is printed. A complete game creature still needs explicit ordinary actions and a useful behavior when breath is unavailable.
options: Use accepted ordinary actions and the full breath as its only authored offense.
Author additional narrowly justified native attacks or maneuvers with complete numeric profiles and clear shared budgets.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not claim optional extra attacks were in the source. No attack happens for free on creation; state command hearing/perception, creation-turn eligibility and defensive behavior.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Fire serpent and fire cone do not themselves supply terrain ignition, molten fluid, light, smoke, heat damage to cargo or harvestable fuel.
options: Apply only already-authored environmental/object consequences actually triggered by the breath or body.
Add specifically bounded environmental expressions with complete rates, geometry, object targeting and endings.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Keep the printed fire damage while distinguishing visual presentation from mechanics. Any persistent fire/terrain result must have a real source, finite lifecycle and conserved objects; real carried property does not become conjured loot.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Planar Army promises an army of extraplanar creatures to serve. Actual Faction Army creates temporary representations; Greater Planar Ally creates a source-local body. Neither decides this source identity.
options: A complete created army with explicit extraplanar source classification and no invented native-plane history.
A real called contingent with individual persistent identities, eligibility/consent, source locations and an actual return contract.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on the word army and the service promise. No default conscription of named NPCs, duplication of possessions, new divine authority or universal plane taxonomy. Genuine travel tests apply only to actual transit.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No soldier count, composition, formation size, quality or CR is printed. Copying Faction Army 3d6/HP20 would be a new design choice, not source recovery.
options: A fixed army-scale count with one or more complete profiled unit roles.
A declared bounded composition budget with complete qualifying profiles and deterministic count/selection.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Supply an actual positive army, not an undefined placeholder or one unrelated pet. Explain its capabilities at 26RP and its one-minute source without claiming balance approval. Every unit has its own body, HP, gear, location and eligibility.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: An army may inherit the shared one-companion offensive Action, but that creates a consequential throughput choice. Faction Army currently allows only one soldier to spend that allowance.
options: Preserve the exact inherited one-soldier offensive command, with a complete account of the army's other useful service.
Author a bounded cohort command/offense exception giving a stated set of real unit actions within one owner transaction.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Discuss the intended benefit rather than silently copying a weak or broad rule. A cohort action must still resolve each body's reach, path, save, ammo, damage root and interruption. No tabletop aggregation may erase separate targets or casualties.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core gives120ft range but no deployment radius, fitting policy, predeclaration or partial-formation rule for many bodies.
options: Predeclare ordered legal whole-body spaces and form only the selected still-valid count with exact partial-success rules.
Require a fully legal complete declared formation and define an atomic all-or-nothing establishment.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Bind real visibility, LoE, height/support, no overlap, inter-unit order and hidden invalidity after payment. Any partial cohort must have an explicit identity/replacement rule; it grants no after-roll search, crushing or automatic escape.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Serve you is broader than an attack, while the one-minute duration and actual expedition jobs forbid inventing completed watches, labor output, institutional rank or proficiency.
options: Allow complete profiled combat/manipulation/transport services with actual time, capacity and commands.
Also authorize specified skilled tasks by giving complete proficiencies and linking real existing job records.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve meaningful service without phantom offscreen progress. Materials, worker identity, movement, working time and custody remain real; a conjured uniform grants no faction permission, training, tax exemption or Extraction.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A one-minute concentration army needs individual casualties, local suppression, whole-parent endings and any true returned-person behavior reconciled.
options: Generated bodies end under a selected finite-body policy, with external cargo settled at actual positions.
Called beings retain underlying bodies and use a separately authored lawful return/stranding policy at each ending.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Resolve blocked returns, plane separation, independent dispel of one body versus parent, Null-disabled soldiers and foreign passengers individually. No global rescue immunity, fresh loot or batch recreation of dead units.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source calls a UNIQUE CR15+ celestial, elemental or outsider to aid you. Unique might identify a real named being, or a uniquely instantiated herald; neither reading is already settled.
options: A genuinely existing eligible unique individual with actual availability, identity and retained resources.
A specifically authored unique herald identity/manifestation with a registry and complete source-local definition, explicitly selected as NEW.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Keep unique meaningful across recasts, casters, control and concurrent manifestations. No generic unnamed unrated profile may quietly replace it. A new herald must not silently become a canonical god or rewrite an established NPC.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: CR15+ is an inclusive lower bound with no printed upper cap. The supplied72-entry bestiary includes the Director-sealed CR22 Elemental Lumen, but a source stat block is not an operationally accepted summon profile.
options: Bind an actually eligible complete native profile and resolve every missing field before claiming a positive case.
Author and disclose a complete new eligible profile/selection policy, preserving15+ as a separate rating and balance obligation.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not invent a ceiling or relabel an unrated creature CR15. Keep exact type, unique status, defenses/actions/body/gear/agency/source clocks explicit. Lumen is evidence of a candidate, not automatic availability, consent or approval; Fiend is not automatically Outsider.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Aid you does not explicitly grant domination, universal obedience, secret extraction, free finite powers, a bargain price or willing consent.
options: A source-local cooperative aid contract with explicit willingness/availability and bounded commands.
A specific spell-created service relation with explicit agency, permitted acts and conflict limits.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Return actual useful aid and precise refusal/illegality behavior without making every positive case a rejection. Name any cost or permission added as NEW; no hidden deity veto, compulsory oath violation or free resource refresh.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Arrival and ending depend on the selected identity. Lumen's preserved source specifically says it cannot be permanently displaced from its arena while its Seal is active; that does not automatically answer a temporary call.
options: Actual transport with source-specific eligibility, legal endpoints, travel guards and a fully specified return.
A source-local manifestation while preserving the distinct existing identity and prohibiting ungranted duplicate bodies or arena benefits.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on the actual Gate-bound text if using that candidate. No blanket immunity to Anchor/wards, automatic bypass of arena objectives, stolen Gate rewards or invented forced-return exception. Preserve its source and the public/Director knowledge boundary.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The herald may have real knowledge, equipment, spellcasting, finite uses and continuing effects. Summoning does not inherently disclose every hidden record or refresh anything.
options: Use the exact selected being's extant resources, knowledge permissions and agency, conserved across arrival/return.
Define a complete finite manifestation resource budget distinct from the original, explicitly resolving what information and child effects it can produce.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Keep real spell costs/components/repertoire/concentration/cadence, gear custody and downstream effect expiry. Aid is not automatic prophecy, all research completion or disclosure beyond the failed Sixth Gate. Supply complete positive ability use before calling the case complete.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Avatar of Decay prints HP250, aura of rot and commands all undead. It does not explicitly assign the avatar itself an Undead type, anatomy, attacks or immunity.
options: An explicitly typed complete generated profile with the printed HP and both substantive benefits.
A source-qualified existing profile only if all required properties and identity rules are independently supported.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not infer a lich, deity, auto-resurrection, necrotic immunity, spell list or personal soul. State the exact effect of actual type on healing, Null, banishment and acquired maximum-HP features.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Aura of rot lacks numeric effect, radius, affected categories, damage type, trigger and save. Rot is not automatically disease, corrosion, maximum-HP loss, crop death or object destruction.
options: A fully quantified damage aura with exact body/LoE/recipient/timing/save rules.
A fully quantified rot rider or damage-plus-rider aura, explicitly authored with all lifecycle and stacking fields.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve a real useful aura. Resolve living, Undead, allies, caster, objects and environmental targets as stated choices; do not silently substitute a mere visual or add unlimited permanent decay.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Commands ALL UNDEAD has no printed numeric cap, CR limit or own-summons qualifier. Command Undeath's exactlyCR2/two-body limit is source-local and cannot be imported.
options: A spatially bounded all-eligible-Undead command relation with no hidden count/CR cap.
Another explicit complete admission/channel model retaining the all-undead promise and explaining its reach.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on range, perception, LoE, plane, PCs/bosses, allies/enemies and classification transitions. Do not narrow it to owned pets, count corpses as Undead creatures, or infer a global cosmological command channel.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Control can collide with existing Command Undeath, Wizard/Mage ownership and other actual control sources. All-undead wording does not name a save, Charm type or universal newest-effect priority.
options: Explicit automatic admission with stated actual hard-control and source-specific immunity/priority handling.
An expressly NEW save or contest model with a defined admission point and preserved printed broad eligibility.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose and justify any added resistance. Identify original caster, acting avatar, controlling character, target and encounter guard keys; no fresh guard per summon. Preserve native ownership/resources and every competing relation rather than deleting history.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The caster commands the avatar, which commands other Undead. The source does not state whether one paid command propagates, each target needs a command, or all can act independently.
options: A complete bounded chain of command using existing real opportunities and exact shared allowances.
A named all-undead command exception with explicit per-body scheduled execution and cross-owner reservations.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Make all-undead control operationally useful while keeping costs explicit. Do not grant a companion an invented owner turn, refresh independent initiatives, charge an unwilling original owner a phantom Bonus Action, or erase another source's structural caps.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The avatar expires after one minute of concentration, but the command relation and pending orders have no separate stated lifetime. Suppression of aura, body and control can occur independently.
options: Tie each created control relation to the live avatar source and its own actual scope, ending cleanly with the parent.
Select a distinct explicitly bounded relation lifetime only if justified, preserving every underlying creature and actual schedule.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify loss of reach, avatar/caster death, suppression, ending, resumption and multiple avatars. Clear spent/expired orders without replay; restore actual agency without a new turn, free heal, allegiance or loot. Independent aura effects retain their own lawful endpoints.

sourceFindings: All five are rank9/class17/base26RP, Action/120ft/V,S,F. Four have concentration up to one minute; Wyrm uniquely has Core Instantaneous. These known fields are not reopened as questions.

Druid/Mage/Wizard access the three Conjuration identities. Herald is Divination through Cleric/Wizard; Decay is Necromancy through Cleric/Druid/Wizard. Mage does not inherit the last two and Cleric does not inherit the Conjuration trio.

Elemental Avatar retains180HP,three attacks per round,plural elemental resistances and actual aura damage. Wyrm retains250HP,a massive serpent body and6d12 fire cone. No nominal label substitutes for complete effects.

Planar Army retains an army of extraplanar creatures serving the caster. Herald retains a unique eligible creature and open-endedCR15+ lower bound. Decay retains250HP,real aura of rot and commands all undead without silently importing Command Undeath's two/exactCR2 limits.

Accepted ordinary command/attached-phase rules are supplied in full. Explicit multiple attacks can share one offensive Action; extra turns do not multiply numbered-round allowances. Army and chained undead command throughput are consequential unresolved source-local choices.

Complete applied AC4/AC5/AC6 comparisons show source-specific healing/suppression/creation and transport decisions. Their current accepted procedures govern stale internal proposal labels; the new five do not inherit every exception by analogy.

Actual Companion10 exact05 source/model/casebook/register/acceptance and its two held exactCR2 cases are included unchanged. Control15 and preparation-only copied Ready context remain accepted-but-unapplied and scoped; the independent five positive-content holds remain open.

The bounded original bestiary scan covers67 public and5 Director-sealed entry files, all preserved in full. Lumen is printed Large Elemental/CR22, has a Gate-bound clause, fragmentary Sixth-Gate disclosure limits and incomplete action geometry. That is a genuine source candidate, not an approved eligible summon or globally exhaustive search.

Original cosmology manuscripts, saved website, current owner corrections and Q6 are supplied. Avatar,extraplanar,herald andUndead do not invent native planes,soul identity,divine authority,Hunt exceptions or an Equation.

Full real body,source,gear,resource,clock,agency and job identities must survive control/transport/suppression/ending. Literal fictional complexity is handled by software; no tabletop simplification is an active requirement.

futureCaseRequirements: At least two complete source-qualified positive encounters per identity, plus meaningful independent branches. Supply actual original class/access/repertoire/automatic features,real26RP transaction,all current modifiers,body coordinates/height/mass/support,actual actor opportunities,RNG,transitions and final state. A native source-only stat block is not an executable test premise.

Elemental Avatar: all three independently resolved strikes and real passive aura; one miss/critical/blocked later target; actual resistance against mixed damage; different-source control/extra-turn stress without fourth attack or duplicate root.

Wyrm: lawful massive whole-body formation and exact6d12 cone against multiple recipients with distinct cover/defenses; complete second use/frequency/lifespan example; no inferred fuel,terrain burning or free ordinary attack.

Army: full actual multi-unit count/composition/deployment,one obstruction,explicit command throughput and useful service; independent casualties/Null/local suppression,cargo settlement and whole-parent ending with no fabricated army-wide state.

Herald: an actually complete eligibleCR15+unique profile,positive useful aid and source-bound knowledge/resource use; concurrent call/availability,unique identity,transport/manifestation choice,blocked return and actual Gate-bound restrictions where relevant. Retain a content hold until a real positive profile is supplied and reviewed.

Decay: real aura plus commands over several independently sourced Undead including one not already owned; competing relation/admission/immunity/hard-guard facts,real independent and attached schedules,full chain of command and restoration of original agency.

Every body: ordinary zero versus qualifying NullDisabled0,actual legal healing or missing-target guard,concentration/expiry/dispel/full and rider-only suppression,unsupported Falling,actual gear and pending-placement conservation. Creation and resumption never refill old budgets or source clocks.

Source packaging checks are not authored acceptance. Arithmetic/specification checks are not engine execution; finite profile ratings,positive content prerequisites,human gameplay,balance,cosmology and whole-game/release approval remain distinct.
